 BEGIN

 AND :MODEL_YEAR IS NOT NULL
 AND :ACTUAL_FUEL_ECONOMY IS NOT NULL
 THEN

 IF (:IS_KM_EXCEED_LIMIT = 1 OR V_CAR_AGE >= 2)
 THEN

 dcltn.CALC_WHAT_IF_FEES_USED_CARS (:CURRENT_SR_VALUE,

 :MODEL_YEAR,
 :ACTUAL_FUEL_ECONOMY,

 :LOW_ENERGY_FEES);

/* CGTE$BLK_LEVEL_ERROR_TRAP */
/* Trap errors returning from the server and report in a user friendly manner */
BEGIN
 DECLARE
 err_code CONSTANT NUMBER := ERROR_CODE;
 err_type CONSTANT VARCHAR2(3) := ERROR_TYPE;
 server_err NUMBER := abs(DBMS_ERROR_CODE);
 server_msg VARCHAR2(2000) := DBMS_ERROR_TEXT;
 constraint_name VARCHAR2(61);
 BEGIN
 IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code IN (40506, 40508, 40509, 40510) ) THEN

 /* Remove recursive errors from the top of the stack */
 WHILE (server_err = 604) LOOP
 CGTE$POP_ERROR_STACK(server_err, server_msg);
 END LOOP;

 /* Check and report the generic constraint violations */
 IF ( CGTE$CHECK_CONSTRAINT_VIO(server_err, server_msg) ) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 /* Check and report the constraint violations specific to this block */
 constraint_name := CGTE$STRIP_CONSTRAINT(server_msg);

 /* FK - Parent key not found */
 IF (server_err = 2291) THEN
 IF (constraint_name = 'D_USD_VH_VSC1_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'رقم مسلسل المواصفة' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'D_USD_VH_STITMS_FK') THEN

 ELSE
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 END IF;
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 /* FK - Child record found */
 IF (server_err = 2292) THEN
 IF (err_code = 40509) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 END IF;
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code = 40735 ) THEN


 /* Remove recursive errors from the top of the stack */
 WHILE (server_err = 604) LOOP
 CGTE$POP_ERROR_STACK(server_err, server_msg);
 END LOOP;

 /* If error not found, issue default message */
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(err_type||'-'||to_char(server_err)||': '||server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 /* If error not found, issue default message */

 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;

 END;

/* CGTE$CHECK_CONSTRAINT_VIO */
FUNCTION CGTE$CHECK_CONSTRAINT_VIO(
 P_SERVER_ERR IN NUMBER /* Server error message */
 ,P_SERVER_MSG IN VARCHAR2) /* Server error number */
RETURN BOOLEAN IS
/* Check and report Primary/Unique Key, Check Constraint and User */
/* Defined Constraint violations */
 constraint_name VARCHAR2(61); /* Violated constraint */
BEGIN
 /* Check if the error code is one we are interested in */
 IF ( NOT (P_SERVER_ERR IN (1, 2290) OR
 (P_SERVER_ERR >= 20000 AND P_SERVER_ERR <= 20999) ) )
 THEN
 RETURN( FALSE );
 END IF;

 /* Deal with user defined errors */
 IF (P_SERVER_ERR >= 20000 AND P_SERVER_ERR <= 20999) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(''||CGTE$STRIP_FIRST_ERROR(P_SERVER_MSG), 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 RETURN( TRUE );
 END IF;

 /* Deal with Primary/Unique Key and Check Constraint violations */
 constraint_name := CGTE$STRIP_CONSTRAINT(P_SERVER_MSG);
 IF (P_SERVER_ERR = 1) THEN
 IF (constraint_name = 'D_USD_VH_SPCFC_PK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(6, 'Row exists already with same <p1>', 'رمز الجمرك,مفتاح الجدول' ), 'E', 'OFG', 6);
 ELSE
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(P_SERVER_MSG, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 END IF;
 ELSIF (P_SERVER_ERR = 2290) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(P_SERVER_MSG, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 END IF;
 RETURN( TRUE );
END;

/* Formatted on 19/06/22 10:46:32 ? (QP5 v5.294) */
FUNCTION CAN_CALC_FEES_USED_CARS (P_PORT_CD NUMBER,
 P_ITEM_ISN NUMBER,
 P_DCLTN_TYPE NUMBER) --1 DECLARATION , 2 STATS)
 RETURN NUMBER
IS

 V_IMPR_NBR NUMBER;
 V_FEES_USED_CARS_5060 NUMBER
 := NVL (gnrl.get_customs_setting ('FEES_USED_CARS_5060', 21), 0);
 V_TRF_CD_STRT_LIT_CARS NUMBER ;
 -- := NVL (gnrl.get_customs_setting ('TRF_CD_STRT_LIT_CARS', 21), 0);
 V_FEES_USED_CARS_DATE DATE
 := TO_DATE (NVL (gnrl.get_customs_setting ('FEES_USED_CARS_DATE', '21'), '01-01-1450'),'MI-MM-YYYY') ;
 V_TARGETED_FUEL_SEDAN NUMBER
 := NVL (gnrl.get_customs_setting ('TARGETED_FUEL_SEDAN', 21), 0);
 V_TARGETED_FUEL_JEEP NUMBER
 := NVL (gnrl.get_customs_setting ('TARGETED_FUEL_JEEP', 21), 0);
 V_MIN_FEES_EXP_OLD_CAR NUMBER
 := NVL (gnrl.get_customs_setting ('MIN_FEES_EXP_OLD_CAR', 21), 0);
 V_MAX_FEES_EXP_OLD_CAR NUMBER
 := NVL (gnrl.get_customs_setting ('MAX_FEES_EXP_OLD_CAR', 21), 0);
 V_DCLTN_DT DATE;
 V_TARIFF_CD NUMBER;
 V_FLAG1 NUMBER := 0;
 V_FLAG2 NUMBER := 0;
 V_FINAL_FLAG NUMBER := 0;
 V_IMPR_TYPE_CD NUMBER;
 V_BUS_ID_TYPE_CD NUMBER;
 V_CAR_AGE NUMBER;
 V_CURRENT_YEAR NUMBER;
 V_DCLTN_TYPE_CD NUMBER;
BEGIN
 V_FLAG1 := 0;
 V_FLAG2 := 0;
 V_FINAL_FLAG := 0;

 IF P_DCLTN_TYPE = 1
 THEN --DECLARATION
 SELECT DC.IMPR_NBR,
 DC.DCLTN_DT,
 DI.FINAL_TARIFF_CD,
 DC.DCLTN_TYPE_CD
 INTO V_IMPR_NBR,
 V_DCLTN_DT,
 V_TARIFF_CD,
 V_DCLTN_TYPE_CD
 FROM DCLTN_ITEMS DI, DECLARATIONS DC
 WHERE DI.PORT_CD = DC.PORT_CD
 AND DI.DCLTN_ISN = DC.DCLTN_ISN
 AND DI.PORT_CD = P_PORT_CD
 AND DI.ITEM_ISN = P_ITEM_ISN;

 IF V_FEES_USED_CARS_5060 = 1 AND V_DCLTN_DT >= V_FEES_USED_CARS_DATE
 THEN

 IF V_DCLTN_TYPE_CD IN (1, 2)
 THEN
 IF NOT ( :EXEMPT_DUE_FINCIAL_CONSDRATN = 1
 AND :EXEMPTION_CONFIRM <> 2)
 THEN
 IF SUBSTR (V_TARIFF_CD, 1, 4) <> V_TRF_CD_STRT_LIT_CARS
 THEN
 V_FINAL_FLAG := 5;
 RETURN V_FINAL_FLAG;
 ELSE
 SELECT IMPR_TYPE_CD, BUS_ID_TYPE_CD
 INTO V_IMPR_TYPE_CD, V_BUS_ID_TYPE_CD
 FROM IMPORTERS
 WHERE PORT_CD = P_PORT_CD AND IMPR_NBR = V_IMPR_NBR;

 IF NOT ( (V_IMPR_TYPE_CD = 4 AND V_BUS_ID_TYPE_CD = 5)
 OR ( V_IMPR_TYPE_CD = 4
 AND V_BUS_ID_TYPE_CD = 3
 AND :IS_PREMIUM_IQAMA = 1)OR V_IMPR_TYPE_CD = 9 )
 THEN
 V_FINAL_FLAG := 5;
 RETURN V_FINAL_FLAG;
 ELSE
 SELECT TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'YYYY')
 INTO V_CURRENT_YEAR
 FROM DUAL;
 V_CAR_AGE := (TO_NUMBER (V_CURRENT_YEAR) - :MODEL_YEAR);

 IF (:IS_KM_EXCEED_LIMIT = 1 AND V_CAR_AGE >= 2)
 THEN
 IF ( ( :VHCL_KIND = 1
 AND :ACTUAL_FUEL_ECONOMY <
 V_TARGETED_FUEL_SEDAN)
 OR ( :VHCL_KIND = 2
 AND :ACTUAL_FUEL_ECONOMY <
 V_TARGETED_FUEL_JEEP))
 THEN
 V_FLAG1 := 1;
 END IF;

 IF (V_CAR_AGE >= 6)
 THEN
 V_FLAG2 := 1;
 END IF;
 ELSE
 V_FINAL_FLAG := 5;
 RETURN V_FINAL_FLAG;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 IF V_FLAG1 = 1 AND V_FLAG2 <> 1
 THEN
 V_FINAL_FLAG := 1;
 ELSIF V_FLAG1 <> 1 AND V_FLAG2 = 1
 THEN
 V_FINAL_FLAG := 2;
 ELSIF V_FLAG1 = 1 AND V_FLAG2 = 1
 THEN
 V_FINAL_FLAG := 3;
 END IF;

 RETURN V_FINAL_FLAG;
 ELSE

 V_FINAL_FLAG := 4;
 RETURN V_FINAL_FLAG;
 END IF;
 ELSE
 V_FINAL_FLAG := 5;
 RETURN V_FINAL_FLAG;
 END IF;
 ELSE
 --STR.DISPALERT('تاريخ البيان خارج تاريخ التطبيق ' ,'ERROR');
 V_FINAL_FLAG := 5;
 RETURN V_FINAL_FLAG;
 END IF;
 END IF;
EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS
 THEN
 --STR.DISPALERT('لا يوجد بيانات تحقق المطلوب' ,'ERROR');
 --V_FINAL_FLAG := 5;
 RETURN V_FINAL_FLAG;
END CAN_CALC_FEES_USED_CARS;

ProgramUnit.Name: CALC_ADDITIONAL_FEES_USED_CARS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION CALC_ADDITIONAL_FEES_USED_CARS (P_PORT_CD NUMBER,
 P_ITEM_ISN NUMBER,
 P_DCLTN_TYPE NUMBER,
 P_OVERAGE_FEES OUT NUMBER,
 P_LOW_ENERGY_FEES OUT NUMBER) --1 DECLARATION , 2 STATS)
 RETURN NUMBER
 IS
 V_FLAG NUMBER;
 V_TARGETED_FUEL_SEDAN NUMBER
 := NVL (gnrl.get_customs_setting ('TARGETED_FUEL_SEDAN', 21), 0);
 V_TARGETED_FUEL_JEEP NUMBER
 := NVL (gnrl.get_customs_setting ('TARGETED_FUEL_JEEP', 21), 0);
 V_OVERAGE_CARS_FEES NUMBER
 := NVL (gnrl.get_customs_setting ('OVERAGE_CARS_FEES', 21), 0);
 V_MIN_FEES_EXP_OLD_CAR NUMBER
 := NVL (gnrl.get_customs_setting ('MIN_FEES_EXP_OLD_CAR', 21), 0);
 V_MAX_FEES_EXP_OLD_CAR NUMBER
 := NVL (gnrl.get_customs_setting ('MAX_FEES_EXP_OLD_CAR', 21), 0);
 V_RATE NUMBER;
 V_INV_COST NUMBER;
 V_FEES_OVERAGE NUMBER :=0;
 V_FEES_FUEL NUMBER :=0 ;
 V_TOTAL_FEES NUMBER :=0 ;
 V_INV_CURCY_CD NUMBER;
 V_DCLTN_DT DATE;
 V_CURRENT_SR_VALUE NUMBER;
 V_CURRENT_YEAR VARCHAR2 (50);
 V_CAR_AGE NUMBER;
 BEGIN
 IF P_DCLTN_TYPE = 1
 THEN
 SELECT
 DI.INV_COST,
 DIV.INV_CURCY_CD,
 DC.DCLTN_DT
 INTO
 V_INV_COST,
 V_INV_CURCY_CD,
 V_DCLTN_DT
 FROM
 DCLTN_ITEMS DI,
 DCLTN_INVOICES DIV,
 DECLARATIONS DC
 WHERE DI.PORT_CD= P_PORT_CD
 AND DI.ITEM_ISN =P_ITEM_ISN
 AND DI.PORT_CD = DIV.PORT_CD
 AND DI.INV_ISN = DIV.INV_ISN
 AND DC.PORT_CD = DI.PORT_CD
 AND DC.DCLTN_ISN = DI.DCLTN_ISN
 AND DC.PORT_CD = DIV.PORT_CD
 AND DC.DCLTN_ISN = DIV.DCLTN_ISN;


 V_FLAG :=
 CAN_CALC_FEES_USED_CARS (P_PORT_CD, P_ITEM_ISN, P_DCLTN_TYPE);
 V_RATE := REVENUE.GET_CURRENCY_RATE (V_INV_CURCY_CD, V_DCLTN_DT);
 V_CURRENT_SR_VALUE := V_INV_COST * V_RATE;

 IF V_FLAG IN (1,3)
 THEN
 IF :VHCL_KIND = 1
 THEN
 V_FEES_FUEL :=
 ( (V_TARGETED_FUEL_SEDAN - :ACTUAL_FUEL_ECONOMY) / 10)
 * V_CURRENT_SR_VALUE;
 ELSIF :VHCL_KIND = 2
 THEN
 V_FEES_FUEL :=
 ( (V_TARGETED_FUEL_JEEP - :ACTUAL_FUEL_ECONOMY) / 10)
 * V_CURRENT_SR_VALUE;
 END IF;
 ELSIF V_FLAG IN (2, 3)
 THEN
 SELECT TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'YYYY') INTO V_CURRENT_YEAR FROM DUAL;

 V_CAR_AGE := (TO_NUMBER (V_CURRENT_YEAR) - :MODEL_YEAR);

 IF V_CAR_AGE >= 6
 THEN
 V_FEES_OVERAGE :=
 V_OVERAGE_CARS_FEES * (V_CAR_AGE - 5) * V_CURRENT_SR_VALUE;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 P_OVERAGE_FEES := V_FEES_OVERAGE;
 P_LOW_ENERGY_FEES := V_FEES_FUEL;
 V_TOTAL_FEES := V_FEES_OVERAGE + V_FEES_FUEL;

 IF V_TOTAL_FEES < V_MIN_FEES_EXP_OLD_CAR
 THEN
 V_TOTAL_FEES := V_MIN_FEES_EXP_OLD_CAR;
 END IF;

 IF V_TOTAL_FEES > (V_CURRENT_SR_VALUE * V_MAX_FEES_EXP_OLD_CAR)
 THEN
 V_TOTAL_FEES := (V_CURRENT_SR_VALUE * V_MAX_FEES_EXP_OLD_CAR);
 END IF;

 RETURN V_TOTAL_FEES;
 END IF;
 END CALC_ADDITIONAL_FEES_USED_CARS;
